title: Transcriptomic analyses reveal regulatory plasticity and metabolic reprogramming underlying genotype-specific microspore embryogenesis in wheat.
authors: Yuan, Hai Ying; Jiang, Yunfei; Kathiria, Palak; Bollina, Venkatesh; Tan, Yifang; Enns, Jean L; Ferrie, Alison M R; Kagale, Sateesh
one_liner_zh: 该文通过转录组分析小麦小孢子胚胎发生中的基因表达重编程，聚焦表观遗传与代谢，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Embryogenic efficiency in wheat microspores is driven by epigenetic regulation, homoeolog expression bias, and genotype-specific genomic variation, with coordinated remodeling of metabolic pathways and cell-wall dynamics establishing a favourable cellular environment. Microspore embryogenesis is a process in which immature male gametophytes are induced to form embryo-like structures that can regenerate into doubled haploid (DH) plants following chromosome doubling. By producing complete homozygosity in a single generation, DH technology accelerates cultivar development and is particularly valuable for breeding resilient crops. However, bread wheat remains largely recalcitrant to microspore embryogenesis, with strong genotype dependence limiting its broad application in breeding programs. Here, we performed a comparative transcriptomic time-course in two spring wheat cultivars with contrasting embryogenic responses: Nanda (highly responsive) and Sadash (recalcitrant). Dynamic gene expression reprogramming was observed during embryogenesis, with Nanda exhibiting enrichment of biological processes associated with epigenetic regulation, including nucleosome assembly, chromatin remodeling, and chromatin organization. In addition, genes related to stress perception, hormonal signaling, cytoskeletal and cell wall dynamics, and metabolic pathways showed coordinated expression changes, collectively characterizing the transcriptional landscape associated with successful microspore embryogenesis. Differentially expressed gene (DEG) hotspots identified structural variation underlying the divergent responses between genotypes. Machine learning highlighted potential biomarkers, notably a histone deacetylase gene TRAESCS1D02G454400 located within a DEG-enriched region. Subgenome-specific analysis revealed pronounced suppression of B-subgenome homoeologs in Sadash, 65% of which overlapped with DEGs from the genotype comparison. These findings highlight the role of epigenetic regulation, homoeolog expression bias, and genotype-specific genomic variation in determining embryogenic efficiency. Importantly, these conclusions are based on transcriptomic associations and require functional validation, while providing candidate molecular targets and biomarkers to overcome recalcitrance and enhance the utility of microspore embryogenesis in wheat DH breeding.
abstract_zh: 小麦小孢子胚胎发生效率受表观遗传调控、同源基因表达偏倚及基因型特异性基因组变异驱动，代谢途径与细胞壁动态的协同重塑建立了有利的细胞环境。小孢子胚胎发生是诱导未成熟雄配子体形成胚状结构的过程，这些结构在染色体加倍后可再生成双单倍体（DH）植株。通过在一代内产生完全纯合性，DH技术加速了品种开发，对培育抗逆作物尤为有价值。然而，面包小麦对小孢子胚胎发生仍 largely 顽抗，强烈的基因型依赖性限制了其在育种计划中的广泛应用。本研究对两个胚胎发生响应对比鲜明的春小麦品种——Nanda（高响应性）和Sadash（顽抗型）——进行了比较转录组时间序列分析。胚胎发生过程中观察到动态基因表达重编程，Nanda富集了与表观遗传调控相关的生物学过程，包括核小体组装、染色质重塑和染色质组织。此外，与胁迫感知、激素信号、细胞骨架和细胞壁动态及代谢途径相关的基因表现出协调的表达变化，共同刻画了成功小孢子胚胎发生相关的转录景观。差异表达基因（DEG）热点区域揭示了基因型间差异响应背后的结构变异。机器学习突出了潜在生物标志物，特别是位于DEG富集区域内的组蛋白去乙酰化酶基因TRAESCS1D02G454400。亚基因组特异性分析显示，Sadash中B亚基因组同源基因显著抑制，其中65%与基因型比较中的DEG重叠。这些发现强调了表观遗传调控、同源基因表达偏倚及基因型特异性基因组变异在决定胚胎发生效率中的作用。重要的是，这些结论基于转录组关联分析，需功能验证，同时为克服顽抗性并增强小麦DH育种中小孢子胚胎发生的实用性提供了候选分子靶标和生物标志物。
